asked QC1-002: Stage C1, rule 0 and pairing. Transmission row 4's four items (finland t06, korea t15, mit t01, alberta t04) and 14 more lines my rechecks found show the same lean: a second act with concepts of its own (bare removals beside megathread routing, an attack beside its reining in, design beside spot) dropped by both readers and, on class 1 lines, by my own B1 too. I rewrote the five pairing sentences from 'the other under rule 0' to 'both are placed' (gates 10 to 14) and re-placed 16 lines to carry both themes, each with its concepts and the amended clause. Under your guard: 11 of the 16 add a theme no reader and not my B1 placed, 8 of them on class 1 lines. The contract's rule 0 makes one placement the default and allows a second only where one cannot carry the material. Should C1 keep placing both where the pairing sentence and rule 0's exception both hold (each act has concepts of its own and the primary's gate excludes the other), or should the scheme lean to one placement, with the pairing sentences adding the second only above a threshold (for example three concepts)? | meanwhile: Pairing stands as written in gates 10 to 14; the 16 lines stay re-placed; I make no corpus-wide sweep for dropped second themes in C1 beyond what rechecks find, and the revision rate (200 placements by seed) will measure how common the lean is.
